question: President Murmu went to which country in April 2025 to represent India at the funeral of Pope Francis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vatican City**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vatican City** is the correct answer because it is the official residence of the Pope, the spiritual leader of the Catholic Church.
 
• When a Pope passes away, his funeral is traditionally held in Vatican City, which is the sovereign city-state within Rome, Italy.
 
• President Murmu, representing India at the funeral of Pope Francis, would naturally visit Vatican City, as it is the central hub of the Catholic Church and the site of the funeral. *Hence, Vatican City is the correct answer.*
 
• The other options like **Italy, France, or Germany** are incorrect because while Vatican City is geographically surrounded by Italy, it is an independent city-state and not part of Italy.
 
• Pope Francis has been the head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of the Vatican City State since March 13, 2013. His funeral would be held in Vatican City as per tradition. *Hence, Vatican City is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vatican City:**

 
 
• **Vatican City** is the smallest independent state in the world, both by area and population. It covers an area of about 44 hectares (110 acres).
 
• It is located within the city of **Rome, Italy**, but operates as an independent sovereign entity.
 
• The Pope resides in Vatican City, specifically at the **Apostolic Palace**, and the city is governed by the Holy See.
 
 
 
• **Pope Francis:**
 
 
• Pope Francis, born Jorge Mario Bergoglio, became the Pope on **March 13, 2013**. He is the first Pope from the Americas and the first Jesuit Pope.
 
• He is widely recognized for his humility, emphasis on mercy, and focus on issues such as poverty, environmental conservation, and social justice.
 
 
 
• **Funeral of a Pope:**
 
 
• A Pope's funeral is traditionally held in **St. Peter's Basilica** or St. Peter's Square, located in Vatican City.
 
• The ceremony involves a period of mourning, followed by a public Mass attended by world leaders, religious figures, and the faithful.
 
• After the funeral, the Pope is buried in the crypt beneath St. Peter's Basilica.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Protocol for World Leaders:**

 
 
• When a significant religious leader like the Pope passes away, it is customary for heads of states and governments to attend the funeral.
 
• This attendance represents respect for the institution, the leader, and the followers of the religion.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Vatican City:**
 
 
• As the spiritual center of the **Catholic Church**, Vatican City holds tremendous religious and historical importance. It is home to **St. Peter's Basilica**, the Sistine Chapel, and the Vatican Museums.
 
• It also serves as the administrative center for the global Catholic Church.
